accepted_findings.root_validation: Confirmed: the fallback closes stderr without recording that it induced EOF; _stderr can then set stderr_eof on an empty read and the completion predicate has no forced-close exclusion.
accepted_findings.cost_benefit: A single explicit forced-close state plus one completion-predicate condition prevents a concrete false-complete evidence record. The benefit exceeds its minimal complexity and verification risk.

required_action: Persistent S2.P adds only an explicit stderr forced-close marker and excludes forced-close teardown from stderr_log_complete; then same-reviewer closure, focused A1 regression, and independent D1 shard.
preserved_credits: All unrelated green IDs and the accepted natural-EOF repair remain credited. No MCP or hardware action is authorized.
